description: This file defines the 'StateContainer' class within the OrangeHRM installer utility namespace. It manages session-based state persistence and provides methods for storing and retrieving database information, installation progress, user and instance data during the installation process of the OrangeHRM HRM system.

classes.name: StateContainer
classes.description: Manages session-based storage of installation and configuration state for the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to store and retrieve database credentials, user info, registration data, current setup screen, and progress indicators during the installation process.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton pattern to instantiate and retrieve the single instance of StateContainer.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in the session.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key from the session, or returns default if not set.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the session.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the session.

methods.name: getAllAttributes
methods.description: Returns all session data as an array.

methods.name: storeDbInfo
methods.description: Stores database connection information and optional encryption setting into the session.

methods.name: getDbInfo
methods.description: Retrieves stored database connection info from the session.

methods.name: clearDbInfo
methods.description: Clears all stored database connection info from the session.

methods.name: isSetDbInfo
methods.description: Checks if database info has been stored.

methods.name: setCurrentScreen
methods.description: Sets the current installation screen and whether it's an upgrade.

methods.name: getCurrentScreen
methods.description: Retrieves the current installation screen.

methods.name: isUpgrader
methods.description: Checks whether the current process is an upgrade.

methods.name: setCurrentVersion
methods.description: Stores the current version of the system.

methods.name: getCurrentVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current version of the system.

methods.name: storeInstanceData
methods.description: Stores organization, country, language, and timezone info into the session.

methods.name: getInstanceData
methods.description: Returns stored instance (organization) data.

methods.name: storeAdminUserData
methods.description: Stores administrator user details into the session.

methods.name: getAdminUserData
methods.description: Returns stored administrator user data.

methods.name: storeRegConsent
methods.description: Stores user's registration consent status.

methods.name: getRegConsent
methods.description: Returns the user's registration consent status.

methods.name: storeInstanceIdentifierData
methods.description: Stores an identifier for the installation instance.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifierData
methods.description: Returns the stored instance identifier, if any.

methods.name: storeInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Stores initial registration data along with progress flags and timestamp.

methods.name: getInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Retrieves initial registration data, progress, and timestamp.

methods.name: setMigrationCompleted
methods.description: Marks migration as completed.

methods.name: isMigrationCompleted
methods.description: Checks if migration has been marked complete.

methods.name: clearMigrationCompleted
methods.description: Removes migration completion status.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Resets the session while preserving current screen and upgrade status.
